questions.q: What program picks up an approved expense report and begins the handoff to Payables?
options: Process Expense Reimbursement
Create Audit List Rule
Manage Corporate Card Usage Policies
Define Expenses Configuration
questions.explain: Process Expense Reimbursement populates the Payables Open Invoice Interface and invokes Import Payables Invoices for approved reports.

questions.q: What does Process Expense Reimbursement populate before invoking Import Payables Invoices?
options: The General Ledger journal entry screen directly
The Payables Open Invoice Interface tables
The employee's payroll record
The corporate card usage policy
questions.explain: It populates the standard Payables Open Invoice Interface with one child line per eligible expense item before Payables imports the invoice.

questions.q: Who is the payee on the resulting Payables invoice for a company-liability corporate card transaction?
options: The employee who used the card
The employee's manager
The corporate card issuer
The General Ledger
questions.explain: For company-liability card transactions, the company owes the balance directly to the issuer, so the issuer is the payee, not the employee.

questions.q: Why does Oracle route expense reimbursement through the standard Payables invoice process rather than a separate payment mechanism?
options: So that reimbursements automatically inherit existing Payables controls like payment terms, holds, and AP aging reporting
Because Payables invoices are always paid instantly with no review
Because expense reports cannot otherwise be tracked at all
Because it is required by law in every country
questions.explain: Reusing the invoice process means reimbursements get all the existing payment controls and reporting without building a second pipeline.

questions.q: What does the Import Payables Invoices Report show?
options: Only successfully imported invoices, hiding all failures
Invoices that imported successfully along with reasons any invoices failed to import
A list of every employee's salary
The company's full chart of accounts
questions.explain: The report lists both successful imports and specific failure reasons, such as an invalid GL account combination or an inactive payee.
